name: akshar-ime
description: Akshar Devanagari IME — WASM + JS for browsers. Type Roman, get Devanagari. Offline, fast, adaptive.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name akshar_ime ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/akshar_ime.wasm
